records.context: Installer-made copies come first, then discovered user environments, then their editable source checkouts. Discovery checks locations used by supported Windows online and offline installers, Linux and macOS online installers, macOS application bundles and Debian packages, as well as registered conda environments, conventional environment folders and the executing interpreter. It does not search the entire filesystem for unregistered environments or source checkouts.

records.source: Installer-made copies come first, then discovered user environments, then their editable source checkouts. Discovery checks locations used by supported Windows online and offline installers, Linux and macOS online installers, macOS application bundles and Debian packages, as well as registered conda environments, conventional environment folders and the running interpreter. It does not search the entire filesystem for unregistered environments or source checkouts.
records.translation: Först listas kopior som skapats av installationsprogram, sedan upptäckta användarmiljöer och sist deras arbetskopior av källkoden som installerats i redigerbart läge. Sökningen kontrollerar platser som används av stödda installationsprogram för Windows, både online och offline, onlineinstallationsprogram för Linux och macOS, macOS-apppaket och Debian-paket, samt registrerade conda-miljöer, vanliga miljömappar och den tolk som körs. Den söker inte igenom hela filsystemet efter oregistrerade miljöer eller arbetskopior av källkoden.

review_method: AI technical and language peer review against the exact current English source and finder implementation. Reviewed the bounded discovery locations, result ordering, current interpreter and filesystem-search limitation. No human or native-speaker signoff.
